A '''rocket cruiser''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] combat vessel operated by the [[Exocron Airfleet]]. As its name implied, it specialized in long-range rocket attack operations. The ''[[Bremarc]]'' was a rocket cruiser.
